artifactPolicy: Large generated RGB/masks and raw audit reports are retained locally at the pinned paths; generate a fresh directory to reproduce the source input.

checks: Two independent scale1 runs reproduce every input/recipe/environment/source payload and the complete manifest exactly
Existing canonical output refused before changing its files or complete preparation record
Dangling output symlink refused without creating its target
cpuControls.reproductionLimit: Byte-identical manifests verified between two scale1 runs in the same pinned runtime. Runtime file paths and platform metadata mean manifest identity is not promised across installations.
cpuControls.scope: CPU reproducibility and output preservation only; no model/GPU/native window run

existingInputPreflight.scope: Existing CPU reference input preflight only; no model or GPU work

limitations: Correspondence checks compare existing saved pixels, not a second implementation of the RGB generator.
Background and foreground exactness applies only where the same surface is visible in both images and the prior coordinate is in bounds.
Newly revealed background has no visible same-material sample in the previous frame; its mask is checked geometrically, without treating hidden pixels as neural-flow ground truth.
Frame35 RGB/ownership already match final static frames, but its final reveal mask is nonzero; frame36 onward has zero transition reveal.

This verifies synthetic input construction only. No neural output, motion estimator, reset decision, temporal quality, source-rate playback, decoded HDR stream, grain/flash corpus, or physical presentation is assessed.

negativeControls.failure: Negative control: same-screen reveal: 2088 differing elements
negativeControls.type: same-screen foreground subtraction instead of background-coordinate mapping

independentGeometryAudit.scope: CPU saved Float32-bit and geometric-mask verification only; no generator import, pixel rerender, model, GPU, decoder, window, or estimated-flow evaluation.

input.maskLayout: One UInt8 byte per pixel, exactly 0 or 1; tightly packed top-to-bottom HxW at the RGB source dimensions.

maskMeaning.background: Current visible background; complement of foreground.
maskMeaning.backgroundPreviousInBounds: Current background-world point maps inside prior viewport; may also be true on foreground. False at frame0.
maskMeaning.foreground: Current opaque foreground ownership, clipped to viewport.
maskMeaning.newViewportBackground: Current background with no previous in-bounds background-world coordinate. False at frame0; excluded from newly revealed mask.
maskMeaning.newlyRevealedBackground: Current background AND previous coordinate in bounds AND previous foreground at (x+cameraDelta,y). Not same-screen occupancy subtraction.

limitations: Generation/audit durations are CPU preparation timings, not neural throughput measurements.
Exact correspondence applies only to the same visible surface inside both viewports; revealed pixels are classified geometrically.
Synthetic linear BT.2020 working values are not a decoded or mastered HDR10/HLG source or a physical colour reference.
No motion estimator, neural output, reset behavior, temporal quality, source-rate Live, audio/video synchronization, native window or physical display was evaluated.
Grain and global flash are separate remaining corpus cases. Natural animation/live-action evidence keeps its own provenance.
scope: CPU preparation and independent saved-pixel geometry audit of a synthetic temporal-reference input; no neural capture or playback qualification.
